title: Fix concurrent initialization of My Notifications
summary: My Notifications no longer raises an error when two concurrent sessions initialize the same notification row; instead, the losing session reloads the row inserted by the winning session, preserving both users' settings.
key_points: Fixed race condition where concurrent sessions would both find no notification row and attempt to insert, causing the second session to fail with 'already exists' error
Implemented shared insert-or-get operation for all three default-insert helpers to handle concurrent initialization gracefully
Added five deterministic regression tests covering all three table helpers and the platform get/set paths with competing row insertions
Solution avoids locks or commits while ensuring the notification page opens successfully for all concurrent sessions
Covers platform notification status initialization and table-specific/filtered default helpers
quote: Two sessions of the same user can both find no notification row on first use and then race to insert it.
